 * class removes the earlier classes of the groups it overrides: p-2 removes px-4, not the reverse). Port of cn_merge.go.

    public static function merge(array $classes): string
    {

    private static function classKey(string $token): array

    private static function splitVariant(string $token): array

    }

    private static function hasDirectionPrefix(string $core, string $kind): bool
    {
        foreach (['x-', 'y-', 't-', 'r-', 'b-', 'l-', 's-', 'e-'] as $d) {
            if (str_starts_with($core, $kind . $d)) {

            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    private static function spaceAxis(string $core, string $kind, string $n): array
    {
        if (str_starts_with($core, $kind . 'x-')) {
            return ["$n-x", "$n-r", "$n-l", "$n-s", "$n-e"];

        if (str_starts_with($core, $kind . 'y-')) {

        return [];

    private static function isTextSize(string $core): bool
    {
        if (in_array($core, ['text-xs', 'text-sm', 'text-base', 'text-lg', 'text-xl', 'text-2xl', 'text-3xl', 'text-4xl', 'text-5xl', 'text-6xl', 'text-7xl', 'text-8xl', 'text-9xl'], true)) {
            return true;

            $rest = substr($core, 6);
            return $rest !== '' && (ctype_digit($rest[0]) || $rest[0] === '.');
        }
        return false;
    }

    private static function isNumber(string $s): bool
    {
        if (str_starts_with($s, '[')) {
            return true;
        }
        return $s !== '' && strspn($s, '0123456789.') === strlen($s);
    }

        $top = max($l, $n);
        $known = ['1-2', '1-3', '1-4', '2-3', '2-4', '2-6', '3-6'];
        for ($k = $top; $k > $l; $k--) {
            if (in_array("$l-$k", $known, true)) {
                return "$l-$k";
            }
        }
        return (string) min(max($n, 1), $l);
    }

    /** drops a segment of a ", " label equal (case-insensitive) to the one before it */
    public static function uniq(mixed $v): string
    {
        $parts = explode(', ', self::s($v));
        $out = [];
        foreach ($parts as $i => $s) {
            if ($i === 0 || strcasecmp($s, $parts[$i - 1]) !== 0) {
                $out[] = $s;
            }
        }
        return implode(', ', $out);
    }

    public static function words(mixed $v): array
    {
        return explode(' ', self::s($v));
    }

    public static function nbsp(mixed $v): string
    {
        return str_replace(' ', "\u{00A0}", self::s($v));
    }

    public static function nth(mixed $list, mixed $i): mixed
    {
        $l = self::l($list);
        $n = (int) self::n($i);
        return $n >= 0 && $n < count($l) ? $l[$n] : null;
    }

    public static function range(mixed $n): array
    {
        $c = (int) self::n($n);
        return $c > 0 ? range(0, $c - 1) : [];
    }

    public static function max(array $vs): float
    {
        $m = -INF;
        foreach ($vs as $v) {
            $m = max($m, self::n($v));
        }
        return $m;
    }

    public static function min(array $vs): float
    {
        $m = INF;
        foreach ($vs as $v) {
            $m = min($m, self::n($v));
        }
        return $m;
    }

    /** Math.round (halves up) */
    public static function round(mixed $v): float
    {
        return floor(self::n($v) + 0.5);
    }

    public static function count(mixed $items, mixed $field): int
    {
        $n = 0;
        foreach (self::l($items) as $it) {
            if (self::t(self::get($it, [self::s($field)]))) {
                $n++;
            }
        }
        return $n;
    }

    public static function where(mixed $items, mixed $field, mixed $value): array
    {
        if (!self::t($value)) {
            return self::l($items);
        }
        return array_values(array_filter(self::l($items), fn ($it) => self::eq(self::get($it, [self::s($field)]), $value)));
    }

    public static function match(mixed $items, mixed $field, mixed $query): array
    {
        if (!self::t($query)) {
            return self::l($items);
        }
        $q = mb_strtolower(self::s($query));
        return array_values(array_filter(self::l($items), fn ($it) => str_contains(mb_strtolower(self::s(self::get($it, [self::s($field)]))), $q)));
    }

    public static function pick(mixed $items, mixed $id): mixed
    {
        foreach (self::l($items) as $it) {
            if (self::eq(self::get($it, ['id']), $id)) {
                return $it;
            }
        }
        return null;
    }

    public static function sumBy(mixed $items, string $a, string $b): float
    {
        $s = 0.0;
        foreach (self::l($items) as $it) {
            $s += self::n(self::get($it, [$a])) * self::n(self::get($it, [$b]));
        }
        return $s;
    }

    public static function firstOf(mixed $items, string $field): mixed
    {
        $l = self::l($items);
        return $l ? (self::get($l[0], [$field]) ?? '') : '';
    }

    public static function maxBy(mixed $items, string $field): float
    {
        $m = 0.0;
        foreach (self::l($items) as $it) {
            $m = max($m, self::n(self::get($it, [$field])));
        }
        return $m;
    }

    /** an inline style from (property, value, unit) triples */
    public static function css(array $triples): string
    {
        $parts = [];
        for ($i = 0; $i + 2 < count($triples); $i += 3) {
            $parts[] = self::s($triples[$i]) . ':' . self::s($triples[$i + 1]) . self::s($triples[$i + 2]);
        }
        return implode(';', $parts);
    }

    /** the class string of a recipe table for a selection (organisms: base, each key, the matching compounds) */
    public function recipe(string $path, array $sel): string
    {
        $r = $this->json($path);
        $pick = function (string $k) use ($r, $sel): string {
            $v = trim(self::s($sel[$k] ?? null));
            return $v !== '' ? $v : trim((string) ($r['defaults'][$k] ?? ''));
        };
        $parts = [(string) ($r['base'] ?? '')];
        foreach ($r['keys'] ?? [] as $k) {
            $parts[] = (string) ($r['byKey'][$k][$pick($k)] ?? '');
        }
        foreach ($r['compound'] ?? [] as $c) {
            if (self::compoundHits($c, $pick)) {
                $parts[] = (string) ($c['class'] ?? '');
            }
        }
        return CnMerge::merge(array_filter(array_map('trim', $parts), fn ($p) => $p !== ''));
    }

    private static function compoundHits(array $c, callable $pick): bool
    {
        foreach ($c as $k => $want) {
            if ($k === 'class') {
                continue;
            }
            if (!in_array($pick((string) $k), explode('|', (string) $want), true)) {
                return false;
            }
        }
        return true;
    }

    /** a preset value of the kit */
    public function preset(string $path, array $keys): mixed
    {
        return self::get(self::get($this->json($path), ['values']), $keys);
    }

    /** free DOM attributes from (name, value) pairs, as React prints them */
    public static function attrs(array $kv): array
    {
        $out = [];
        for ($i = 0; $i + 1 < count($kv); $i += 2) {
            $k = self::s($kv[$i]);
            $v = $kv[$i + 1];
            if ($v === null) {
                continue;
            }
            if (is_bool($v)) {
                if (str_starts_with($k, 'data-') || str_starts_with($k, 'aria-')) {
                    $out[$k] = self::s($v);
                } elseif ($v) {
                    $out[$k] = true;
                }
                continue;
            }
            $out[$k] = self::s($v);
        }
        return $out;
    }

    /** an attribute map as markup (` name="value"`, a bare name for true, nothing for null and false) */
    public static function attrHtml(mixed $attrs): string
    {
        if (!is_array($attrs)) {
            return '';
        }
        $out = '';
        foreach ($attrs as $k => $v) {
            if ($v === null || $v === false) {
                continue;
            }
            $name = htmlspecialchars((string) $k, ENT_QUOTES | ENT_SUBSTITUTE, 'UTF-8');
            $out .= $v === true ? " $name" : " $name=\"" . htmlspecialchars(self::s($v), ENT_QUOTES | ENT_SUBSTITUTE, 'UTF-8') . '"';
        }
        return $out;
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- bricks (expr.go, utils.go, tags.go)

    public static function isSetStr(mixed $v): bool
    {
        return trim(self::s($v)) !== '';
    }

    public static function defaultIfEmpty(mixed $v, string $fallback): string
    {
        $t = trim(self::s($v));
        return $t === '' ? $fallback : $t;
    }

    /** a decision table over a trimmed text: mapping[trim(v)] or the fallback */
    public static function mapOr(mixed $v, array $mapping, string $fallback, bool $lower = false): string
    {
        $t = trim(self::s($v));
        if ($lower) {
            $t = strtolower($t);
        }
        return array_key_exists($t, $mapping) ? (string) $mapping[$t] : $fallback;
    }

    public static function intMapOr(mixed $v, array $mapping, string $fallback): string
    {
        $n = self::i($v);
        return array_key_exists($n, $mapping) ? (string) $mapping[$n] : $fallback;
    }

    public static function boolStr(mixed $v): string
    {
        return self::t($v) ? 'true' : 'false';
    }

    public static function concatTrim(array $parts): string
    {
        return implode('', array_map(fn ($p) => trim(self::s($p)), $parts));
    }

    /** class fragments merged with tailwind-merge (strings only, empty ones skipped) */
    public static function cn(array $parts): string
    {
        return CnMerge::merge(array_map(fn ($p) => self::s($p), $parts));
    }

    /** the brick class contract: recipe base, the selected variants (defaults for empty), compounds, then the tail */
    public function compose(string $path, array $selection, array $extra): string
    {
        $r = $this->json($path);
        $parts = [];
        if (trim((string) ($r['base'] ?? '')) !== '') {
            $parts[] = trim((string) $r['base']);
        }
        $pick = function (string $k) use ($r, $selection): string {
            $c = trim(self::s($selection[$k] ?? null));
            return $c !== '' ? $c : trim((string) ($r['defaults'][$k] ?? ''));
        };
        foreach ($r['keys'] ?? [] as $key) {
            $choices = $r['byKey'][$key] ?? null;
            if ($choices === null) {
                continue;
            }
            $choice = $pick($key);
            if ($choice === '') {
                if ($choices) {
                    throw new \RuntimeException("[compose] missing default for key $key");
                }
                continue;
            }
            if (isset($choices[$choice]) && trim((string) $choices[$choice]) !== '') {
                $parts[] = (string) $choices[$choice];
            }
        }
        foreach ($r['compound'] ?? [] as $c) {
            if (self::compoundHits($c, $pick) && trim((string) ($c['class'] ?? '')) !== '') {
                $parts[] = (string) $c['class'];
            }
        }
        return self::cn([...$parts, ...$extra]);
    }

    /** the tag of a primitive: the requested one when the allow-list has it, else the fallback */
    public static function resolveTag(mixed $tag, string $fallback, array $allowed): string
    {
        $t = strtolower(trim(self::s($tag)));
        return $t !== '' && in_array($t, $allowed, true) ? $t : $fallback;
    }

    /** h1-h6 from a level, h2 by default */
    public static function titleTag(mixed $level): string
    {
        $n = self::i($level);
        return $n >= 1 && $n <= 6 ? "h$n" : 'h2';
    }

    /** the inner markup of a Lucide glyph: its nodes with attributes in name order (circle for an unknown name) */
    public function lucide(mixed $name): string
    {
        $icons = $this->json('ui/lucide-icon/lucide-icons.json')['icons'];
        $nodes = $icons[self::s($name)] ?? $icons['circle'];
        $out = '';
        foreach ($nodes as [$tag, $attrs]) {
            ksort($attrs, SORT_STRING);
            $out .= '<' . $tag;
            foreach ($attrs as $k => $v) {
                $out .= ' ' . $k . '="' . htmlspecialchars((string) $v, ENT_QUOTES | ENT_SUBSTITUTE, 'UTF-8') . '"';
            }
            $out .= '></' . $tag . '>';
        }
        return $out;
    }
